title: LinkAge Plus activities for over 50s
intro: LinkAge Plus offers classes, activities and practical support for people aged 50 and over in Tower Hamlets.

blocks.heading: What’s on
paragraphs: Choose from gentle exercise, yoga, line dancing, tai chi, singing, arts and crafts, digital support, healthy living workshops and community celebrations. Most sessions are free or low-cost.

blocks.heading: Find a local hub
paragraphs: Activities run at Toynbee Hall Community Centre, Sundial Centre, Age UK East London, Sonali Gardens and Neighbours in Poplar. Contact linkageplus@toynbeehall.org.uk or call 0203 856 9721 for Toynbee Hall sessions. Check the latest timetable before visiting.
